info.title: BaGet UI API
info.description: The JSON twin of every screen of the web UI (/api/ui). Authenticate with an API key as 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' or the X-NuGet-ApiKey header, or, for a person, with a session token ('Authorization: Bearer bgs.xxx') from POST /api/ui/session (a single-page application on any origin). A same-origin client may use the browser cookie if it sends the antiforgery token of GET /api/ui/antiforgery in the X-XSRF-TOKEN header on every request; the bare cookie and HTTP Basic are not accepted. Administration screens need an administrator's key with the admin:api scope and no repository limit, or an administrator's interactive session (the global ApiKey is refused). Account self-service and package ownership screens need an interactive session; API keys are refused with 403.

all.description: Whether the list to come back to shows the resolved reports too.

AbuseForm.description: A decision on an abuse report.

AbuseReportSummary.description: An abuse report with the name of its repository.

isSupported.description: Whether reports are stored with the configured database.

AbuseViewModel.description: What the abuse reports screen (`/admin/abuse`) shows: the reports of every repository.

AccessAction.description:
What a permission grants. Independent flags: AccessAction.Deploy does not imply AccessAction.Read, as in
Artifactory. Package ownership (IPackageAuthorizationService) is a second, separate requirement
for the actions that change an existing package ID.

actor.description: The user name that made the change; null for the server itself.

subject.description: What it happened to (a group, target or repository name).

AccessAuditEntry.description: One change to the access model.

override.description:
A rule that grants everything or bypasses the model (administrator, global API key, no
            access model), instead of Reasons; null when the grants decide.

reasons.description: The grants and project roles that apply to the caller.

AccessExplanation.description: What a caller may do in a repository, and why (Task<AccessExplanation> IAccessEvaluator.ExplainAsync(BaGetPrincipal? principal, RepositoryInfo repository, string? packageId, CancellationToken cancellationToken)).

source.description: Where it comes from, such as `Permission target 'Anyone reads every repository'`.

principalId.description: The principal's id (user id, group or organization key).

principal.description: The principal in words (a user name, `group Developers`, `organization Contoso`).

packages.description: The package filter of the target, such as `Contoso.* except Contoso.Internal.*`; null for all.

note.description: Why AccessAction AccessReason.Effective differs from AccessAction AccessReason.Granted, if it does.

AccessReason.description: One grant or project role behind an access decision, for the admin pages that explain it.

reason.description: Why the access screens are not available.

AccessUnavailableViewModel.description: What the "access control unavailable" screen (`/admin/access-unavailable`) says: why, as the JSON carries it (the page has fixed text).

package.description: A package ID to evaluate the grants for; empty means the repository as a whole.

rows.description: The repositories where the user holds some action.

modelAvailable.description: Whether the configured database has an access model at all.

AccountAccessViewModel.description: The "My access" screen: the signed-in user's own effective permissions.

key.description: The key's id (the number the revoke button posts).

packageGlobPattern.description: The package IDs the key applies to.

AccountApiKey.description: One API key as the screen lists it: never the key itself or its hash (only the creation response shows a new key, once).

isAdmin.description: Whether the current user administers it.
Whether the member administers the organization.

AccountOrganizationMember.description: One member of an organization (a flat record, so the screen's JSON names its fields).

groups.description: The owned packages of each repository that has any, `default` first.

isEmpty.description: Whether the user owns nothing in any repository.

showRepositoryNames.description: Whether the list needs repository headings: more than the default repository holds packages of the user.

AccountPackagesViewModel.description: The "My packages" screen: the packages the user owns in each repository.

isAdmin.description: Whether the new member administers the organization.

AddOrganizationMemberForm.description: What the "add a member" form posts.

directPackageIds.description: Package IDs the user owns directly.

soleOwnedPackages.description: The subset nobody else owns, in every repository.

organizations.description: What happens to each organization the user belongs to.

AdminDeletionPreview.description: What deleting a user as an administrator would remove or change.

message.description: The result on success, the exception type and message on failure.

AdminJobStatus.description: The last run of an operation on a repository. In memory: a restart forgets it.

AdminOrganizationsViewModel.description: What the organizations screen (`/admin/organizations`) lists: every organization with its members and packages.

owners.description: The names of its owners; empty for an ownerless ID.

repositoryName.description: The repository the ID is in; ownership and versions are per repository.

AdminPackageRow.description: A package ID as the administrator pages list it.

packages.description: The ownerless IDs on this page.

showRepository.description: Whether a Repository column is worth showing: some listed ID is outside the default repository.

AdminPackagesViewModel.description: What the ownerless packages screen (`/admin/packages`) shows: the package IDs nobody owns, in every repository.

sectionList.description: The same sections as IReadOnlyList<IGrouping<string, SettingState>> AdminSettingsViewModel.Sections, each with its key and DOM id, as the JSON carries them.

overridesPath.description: The file the settings are saved to.

pendingRestart.description: The keys changed since startup that only apply after a restart.

errors.description: Why the last save was refused.

errorSection.description: The section the IReadOnlyList<string> AdminSettingsViewModel.Errors belong to.

logLevels.description: The per-source log levels (`Serilog:MinimumLevel:Override`) shown under the Serilog section.

logLevelNames.description: The level names offered for a source.

signInProviders.description: The named OpenID Connect providers (`Accounts:OpenIdConnectProviders`) shown in the "Sign-in providers" panel of the Accounts section. No secret is carried.

loadError.description: Why the overrides file could not be read, or null.

telemetrySignals.description: The state of each telemetry signal for the Telemetry section, or null when the host exports no telemetry.

hostExportsTelemetry.description:
True when this host exports telemetry (registers ITelemetryDiagnostics). When false the Telemetry
section stays editable (the settings file may be shared with a host that does export) but a note says it has no effect here.

canCopyDatabase.description:
Whether the running database is relational, so a change of database can copy the data (the "Copy all data" option of the
Database section).

copyTargetTypes.description: The `Database:Type` values a copy can target; the option is hidden for any other type.

selectedId.description:
The DOM id (slug) of the section shown; every other section is rendered `hidden`. Chosen by the workflow: the failed
section, else the Telemetry section after "Test connection", else the `?section=` value, else the first section. The URL
fragment is only known to the browser, so the page's script applies it on load unless bool AdminSettingsViewModel.SelectionLocked.

selectionLocked.description: True when the server picked the section for a reason the URL fragment must not override (a failed save, a connection test).

hasPassword.description: Whether the signed in administrator has a password to confirm with.

reauthenticated.description: For an account without a password: it signed in again with its provider a moment ago.

canReauthenticate.description: Whether an external provider is available to sign in again with.

returnPage.description: The page to come back to after signing in again (the model of the confirmation partial).

AdminSettingsViewModel.description: What the server settings screen (`/admin/settings`) shows: every registered setting by section and the state of the last save.

acceptTerms.description: The confirmation that the uploader may publish the package (required to publish, ignored when discarding).

What the second and third step of the NuGet upload send (publish and discard a staged upload): the handle of the staged file and, while accounts are
off, the API key that authenticates the uploader. The key is read and never echoed in an answer.

id.description:
The package ID a link arrived with, as "upload a new version of this" does. A hint for the page only: the ID and version that
are published are read from the file, never from the request.

accountsEnabled.description: Whether accounts are on (the uploader then signs in).

signedIn.description: Whether the visitor is signed in.

needsApiKey.description: With accounts off there is no user to own an upload, so the pusher proves itself with an API key.

nothingCanAuthenticate.description: Nothing on this server can tell one caller from another (accounts off and no global API key): the browser upload is closed.

noApiKeyExplanation.description: What the page says in that state, so the explanation and the refusal are one sentence.

canUpload.description: Whether to render the form at all.

message.description: What happened, for the page to show.

failed.description: Whether string? UploadViewModel.Message reports a failure.

retryToken.description: The token of a staged upload whose API key was rejected, so the key can be entered again.

statusCode.description: The HTTP status the page is answered with (200, or the refusal's).

UploadViewModel.description: What the NuGet upload page (`/upload`) shows: the form, the preview of a staged file, or the outcome of a step.

isAdministrator.description: Whether it is a server administrator.

pendingApproval.description: Whether it waits for an administrator to enable it.

UserAccountInfo.description: The account an administrator looks at, without anything that signs in as it (no password hash, security stamp or tokens).

userName.description: The account the change applies to.

resetEmail.description: For a password reset: the address to mail the new password to, if the administrator typed one.

UserChange.description: A change to one account from the Users screen, with the list's filter and page to come back to.

newPassword.description: The password typed; empty means generate one (unless Invite).

invite.description: Mail the user a link to choose their own password.

UserCreation.description: A new account from the Users screen.

soleOwned.description: "keep" (default) or "delete": what to do with the package IDs only this user owns.

package.description: A package ID to evaluate the effective permissions for; empty means each repository as a whole.

modelAvailable.description: Whether the configured database has an access model (else the access sections are hidden).

groups.description: The names of the groups the account belongs to (the implicit built-ins excluded).

projectRoles.description: The roles the account holds in projects, directly or through a group.

access.description: What the account may do in each NuGet repository, and why.

keys.description: The account's API keys; the key and its hash are never shown.

organizations.description: The organizations the account belongs to.

ownedPackageIds.description: How many package IDs the account owns, in every repository.

hasPassword.description: Whether the signed in administrator has a password to confirm with.

reauthenticated.description: For an account without a password: it signed in again with its provider a moment ago.

canReauthenticate.description: Whether an external provider is available to sign in again with.

returnPage.description: The page to come back to after signing in again (the model of the confirmation partial).

UserDetailViewModel.description: What the user detail screen (`/admin/users/{name}`) shows: the account, its keys, organizations and access.

UserGroupForm.description: Adding an account to a group or removing it.

UserKeyForm.description: Revoking one of an account's API keys.

description.description: The description the owner gave it.

packageGlobPattern.description: The package IDs it applies to.

repositories.description: Where it may be used: the repositories it is limited to, or "all repositories".

UserKeyRow.description: One of an account's API keys as the administrator sees it; the key itself and its hash are never shown.

name.description: The user name, from the route.

UserPackagesViewModel.description: What the user packages screen (`/admin/users/{name}/packages`) shows: the package IDs one user owns.

UserProjectRole.description: A role a user holds in a project, directly or through a group.

isAdministrator.description: Whether the user is an administrator.

avatarUrl.description: The avatar's address, or null for the initial.

pendingApproval.description: Whether the account waits for an administrator to enable it (`Accounts:RequireApproval`).

UserRow.description: A user as the Users page lists them.

pageNumber.description: One-based page number (the `p` query value; not "page", which Razor Pages reserved for the page path).

pendingCount.description: How many accounts, in all pages, wait for approval.

pageCount.description: The number of pages for the current filter.

currentUserName.description: The signed in administrator's user name; their own row has no actions.

canEmailResetLink.description: Whether a reset link can be mailed: SMTP is configured.

canInvite.description: Whether an invitation (a reset link mailed to the new user) can be offered: SMTP is configured.

generatedPassword.description: The password just generated. Only ever rendered by the response to the reset itself, never kept in TempData or a cookie.

generatedFor.description: The user string? UsersViewModel.GeneratedPassword belongs to.

generatedForNewUser.description: Whether string? UsersViewModel.GeneratedPassword is a new account's first password rather than a reset.

hasPassword.description: Whether the signed in administrator has a password to confirm with.

reauthenticated.description: For an account without a password: it signed in again with its provider a moment ago.

canReauthenticate.description: Whether an external provider is available to sign in again with.

returnPage.description: The page to come back to after signing in again (the model of the confirmation partial).

UsersViewModel.description: What the Users screen (`/admin/users`) shows: the filtered, paged accounts and the state of the last action.

id.description: The package ID from the address.

submissions.description: The newest submission of each version, newest version first.

ValidationStatusViewModel.description: What the validation status screen (`/packages/{id}/validation`) shows; filled by the screen's workflow.

ValidationSubmission.description: One version's newest validation submission and the verdict of every step.

ValidationSubmissionState.description: Where a submission stands: still to run, or stopped without being indexed.

ValidationSubmissionSummary.description: One submission awaiting validation or quarantined.

isSupported.description: Whether validation can be administered here.

hasPassword.description: Whether the signed in administrator has a password to confirm with.

reauthenticated.description: For an account without a password: it signed in again with its provider a moment ago.

canReauthenticate.description: Whether an external provider is available to sign in again with.

returnPage.description: The page to come back to after signing in again (the model of the confirmation partial).

ValidationViewModel.description: What the validation queue screen (`/admin/validation`) shows: pending and quarantined submissions.

exists.description: Whether a repository of that name exists.

VirtualMemberDetail.description: One member of a virtual repository as the administration page lists it.

members.description: Its direct members in resolution order.

deployRepository.description: The name of the member that receives deployments, if any.

effectiveMembers.description: The local and remote repositories that answer, in order, nested virtual members expanded.

VirtualRepositoryDetail.description: A virtual repository as the administration pages edit it.

session.description: A session token: the accessToken of POST /api/ui/session, refreshed with POST /api/ui/session/refresh. Only /api/ui accepts it.
